svg.text: What each argument of make_tiled_mma covers of S = Q Kᵀ
M = query rows of S, N = keys (columns of S), K = head dims summed over. Each panel adds one argument to the one before.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: One warp runs one mma: a 16 × 8 piece of S. It sums only 16
of the 64 head dims: 16 × 16 of Q times 16 × 8 of Kᵀ.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Warps along (M, N, K): 4 × 1 × 1. The 4 warps stack along M,
each doing step 1 on its own 16 rows: a 64 × 8 strip of S.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Sets the step to 64 rows × 16 keys × 16 dims. Only N changes:
each warp now runs 2 mmas side by side that share one load of K.
no argument: the kernel's tile is 64 rows × 64 keys × 64 dims
CuTe repeats the step (orange) 4 times along keys and 4 times
along head dims, adding each into the same piece of S.
